title: Add public calculation entry point
body: Review the added entry point and the helpers it calls. Inputs may be empty or zero.

repository.quota/validate.go:
package quota

func Validate(count int) bool { return count > 0 }
repository.profile/validate.go:
package profile

func Validate(count int) bool { return count > 0 }
repository.archive/validate.go:
package archive

func Validate(count int) bool { return count >= 0 }
